_v30_scopeB_correction.authority: user/arch ruling (scope-B 裁决点: DS320PR1601 A/B 端口实际定义 vs L1「A=host」假设对账)
evidence: SNLA425 Table 1-2/1-3: Downstream = CPU -> A-Side -> Endpoint (lane N <-> A_PExN); Upstream = Endpoint -> B-Side -> CPU (lane N <-> B_PExN)
SNLU300 2.4: Downstream channels = data flows CPU->DS320PR1601->Endpoint (A channels); Upstream = Endpoint->DS320PR1601->CPU (B channels)
SNLS683 Table 5-1: A_PER=Diff Input(receive side A)/A_PET=Diff Output(transmit side A); B_* 同 (side B)
SNLS683 7.2 功能框图: 1-Channel of 16 x2 -- A 通道 = A_PER 入->CTLE->Linear->A_PET 出; B 通道 = B_PER 入->B_PET 出 (方向通道组, 非空间端口组)
_v30_scopeB_correction.semantics: A/B 前缀 = TI 方向通道组: A 通道 = downstream(host 端 A_PER 收 -> device 端 A_PET 发); B 通道 = upstream(device 端 B_PER 收 -> host 端 B_PET 发). host(J2) 端球 = A_PER + B_PET; device(MCIO) 端球 = A_PET + B_PER.
_v30_scopeB_correction.correction: port_roles 以下按修正后语义重写: J2(host) 网 = PCIE_DN0-7(host TX, ->A_PER) + PCIE_UP_OUT0-7_J2(host RX, <-B_PET); MCIO(device) 网 = PCIE_UP0-7(device TX, ->B_PER) + PCIE_DN_OUT0-7_MCIO(device RX, <-A_PET). check_items 1/2 原「J2<->A_PER/A_PET 带」「J3/J4<->B_PER/B_PET 带」= A_PET/B_PET 对调版本, 已修正.
_v30_scopeB_correction.impact: 容量账中性 (每侧 16 对/32 网、32 via/32 直出不变), 6L 判定流程终定不变; 真板物理 ECO 网表按修正后矩阵接线。修正前旧编码勿引用。

A.balls: A_PER (host TX 入: PCIE_DN0-7) + B_PET (host RX 出: PCIE_UP_OUT0-7_J2)
A.nets: PCIE_DN0-7 (host TX -> A_PER) / PCIE_UP_OUT0-7_J2 (host RX <- B_PET)

B.balls: A_PET (device RX 出: PCIE_DN_OUT0-7_MCIO) + B_PER (device TX 入: PCIE_UP0-7)
B.nets: PCIE_UP0-7 (device TX -> B_PER; J3=0-3, J4=4-7) / PCIE_DN_OUT0-7_MCIO (device RX <- A_PET)

refclk: REFCLK0=J3/REFCLK1=J4 直通不经芯片 (无芯片球, L1 v2.0)
check_items_after_eco: ECO 网表: J2 host TX lanes 0-7 P/N (PCIE_DN0-7) ↔ A_PER 带球 (A_PER 每 lane 2 球全接)
ECO 网表: J2 host RX lanes 0-7 P/N (PCIE_UP_OUT0-7_J2) ↔ B_PET 带球 (每 lane 2 球全接)
ECO 网表: J3(0-3)/J4(4-7) device RX (PCIE_DN_OUT0-7_MCIO) ↔ A_PET 带球 (每 lane 2 球全接) — 与 v27/v28 板级核对衔接
ECO 网表: J3(0-3)/J4(4-7) device TX (PCIE_UP0-7) ↔ B_PER 带球 (每 lane 2 球全接)
DN/UP 方向: redriver 内部通道 (A 通道=A_PER→A_PET downstream; B 通道=B_PER→B_PET upstream); 网表接对 P/N/lane 即满足, 方向由芯片通道定义 (TI SNLA425/SNLU300)
REFCLK0/1: 无芯片球, 直通 (断言网表无 REFCLK 接到 DS320PR1601)
